examples.title: Example 1: Displaying a Text Picker Dialog Box
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to display a text picker dialog box when a button is touched.

examples.title: Example 2: Customizing the Style
examples.description: In this example, disappearTextStyle, textStyle, selectedTextStyle, acceptButtonStyle, and cancelButtonStyle are configured to customize the text and button style.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring a Dialog Box in the Hover State
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the layout area of a dialog box when the device is in semi-folded mode.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Dialog Box Position
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the position of a dialog box using alignment and offset.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Mask Area
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the mask area using maskRect.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting the Background
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the dialog box background using backgroundColor, backgroundBlurStyle, and shadow.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Cyclic Scrolling
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set whether to enable cyclic scrolling using canLoop.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting the Background Style of the Selected Item
examples.description:
This example shows how to set the background style of the selected item by configuring selectedBackgroundStyle.
Since API version 20, the selectedBackgroundStyle attribute is added for TextPickerDialogOptions.

examples.title: Example 9: Customizing the Background Blur Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background blur effect by configuring backgroundBlurStyleOptions. This functionality is supported since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 10: Customizing the Background Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background effect by configuring backgroundEffect. This functionality is supported since API version 19.
